selfReport: Yes. The opening hostage scene, including the fish and the android holding a girl on a high-rise terrace, reminded me of Detroit: Become Human. I recognized Cato, Mira, and Elan as counterparts to Connor, Kara, and Markus, and Haven as the counterpart to Jericho. That familiarity influenced where I looked for evidence in the apartment, especially my choice to check the girl’s tablet for the android’s name and to pursue the father’s tablet. It also made me suspect Pia was an android before Mira explicitly learned it, so I can’t treat my response to Elan’s question about her as independent of that knowledge. I made choices from the scenes as they appeared, and I did not look up routes or outcomes. Familiarity with the story is different from knowing how these choices and risks would resolve in this run.
